info.longName: Global X Interest Rate Volatility & Inflation Hedge ETF

funds_data.description: The fund is an actively managed exchange traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective primarily by investing, directly or indirectly, in a mix of U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (“TIPS”) and long yield curve spread options, which are tied to the shape of the U.S. interest rate curve. It is non-diversified.
